name: Fujimori Saya
source:
Fainting when she was about to confess her love to the boy she liked, she was taken to an hospital and was diagnosed with a rare incurable illness... for normal medicine.
She agreed to be part of a series of experimental operations that may be able to save her life, but she had no idea that her body was going to be dramatically changed in the process.
translation:
Fainting when she was about to confess her love to the boy she liked, she was taken to an hospital and was diagnosed with a rare incurable illness... for normal medicine.
